title: Head
description: A simple plugin that lets you use a command to spawn in a player head with a custom texture in exchange for configurable hard currency
body:
A simple plugin that lets you use a command to spawn in a player head with a custom texture in exchange for configurable hard currency

![Head command demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d562bcf648549a111ed513add3142abce294442.gif)

Usage: /head <base64 value> [custom name]

You can easily find these values on e.g. [minecraft-heads.com](https://minecraft-heads.com/) by clicking on the head submission and scrolling down to 'Value'

I coded this for private use a while ago and didn't guard against anything so report any issues in my [discord](https://discord.gg/XycfdKx9JH)
